responsibility: Declares the externally visible MinGW/Windows target helper interfaces implemented in winnt.cc and related sources. It exposes attribute handlers, PE section and LTO assembly hooks, symbol encoding and export-recording helpers, unique-section and section-flag routines, stub recording, and dllimport validation, forming the shared header contract for the module’s Windows PE/COFF backend support.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration header for the core winnt pair: it publishes the callable MinGW/Windows backend hooks such as attribute handlers, section/output helpers, export recording, and dllimport validation, while `winnt.cc` contains the actual target-side implementations and SEH/output logic.
